preconditions.description: Number of gifts is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Pleasantness of each gift is between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.
Length of the pleasantness array matches the number of gifts.
Number of edges is exactly one less than the number of gifts.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct gifts within the valid range.

postconditions.description: Output is either 'Impossible' or an integer.
If not 'Impossible', the sum of pleasantness is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Impossible' or return_value == max(sum(a[i] for i in subtree1) + sum(a[j] for j in subtree2) for subtree1, subtree2 in all_valid_subtree_pairs)
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible sum of pleasantness for two non-intersecting subtrees.
